name: print-social-restorck-restaurant-posts-olive-and-orange-with-floating-leaves
title: Restorck restaurant pack with olive headline bars, orange accents and floating green leaves
whatItIs: Five light posts with olive green headline bars in condensed type ('Lets you Eat Better', 'Heart of Perfect Food Hangout'), orange hashtag tags and 'Open daily' buttons, diners in arch-cropped photos, big opening hours and blurred green leaves floating over the frame.
whatItMeans: Fresh and appetising; floating leaves add depth and a farm-fresh feel.
techniques: Scatter blurred leaves in the foreground for depth.
Set headlines on solid olive bars.
Tag with a hashtag label above the title.

vocabulary.definition: A solid shape holding the title.
